_about: The days of story mode as stage lists (Zafar, 20 Oct: 'built modularly, so it's easy to chop and change the sequence ... swapped in or out easily or replicated and changed for a new day'; docs/game-design/days/README.md §1; the farm's list: docs/game-design/days/farm.md). js/day/day.js plays a day's `stages` in order through one stage interface (start(day, log) -> done) and writes each stage's result to the day log; a stage whose module is not built yet is skipped with a lab note. A new day is a copy of a list with stages swapped, added, removed or reordered: no code (build/test_day_runner.mjs proves it). Each stage is {stage, ...its settings}. The looks, lines and things the stages use stay in data/day.json (weather, activities, trips, window.rides) and data/day-book.json; this file names them. `door` below is the morning door's own look on the s09b art (sky, house, Nani's poses, the sidebar's two cards). Positions are in the art's own pixels.

stages._about: Every stage id a day may use, and its settings. built: js/day/day.js has a module for it today; the rest are skipped (with a lab note) until their sprint builds them (the stage library, docs/game-design/days/README.md §3).

settings.lines: the day's line set: a key of data/day.json activities (kitchen, clinic) or trips (farm, shops)

settings.activity: kitchen | clinic (data/day.json activities: hands off to Cook or the clinic; the evening resumes at the next stage when day.html is opened again)

settings.vehicle: car | bus (the road's own when left out)

settings.place: the book's place (data/day-book.json activityPlace); the day's own activity or trip when left out

settings.for: the weather that sets its kind

settings.game: the place game (feed, eggs, snap, animals-home)

door._about: The morning door on the s09b art (Zafar, 20 Oct, yes to all ten; DOOR-01..04): the sky is its own full layer behind the cut-out empty house, the house scaled so its roofline (y 322 of 1024) sits a third of the way down the play area and covering its width (its sides cropped on squarer screens); code draws only what moves (the rain falling, the stars twinkling, the clouds drifting). Nani is one of her pose cut-outs at 0.6 of the screen height (DOOR-06, Zafar 22 Oct: about 20% bigger, the camera a little closer: house.zoom, centred on her feet, with the foot of the steps at house.footAt of the height), her feet at the foot of the steps (foot, in the house's pixels), her head's middle at head (a share of the pose picture: SH-68, the thought's dots rise from it), every pose at one body height (body: the pose picture's head top and feet bottom rows; the umbrella's top is the umbrella, so its head starts lower; cx: the feet's middle across the picture). Her pose follows her lines (poses). The sidebar's two cards (idea 55): today's weather, then the day's activity, each as its sentence is said, with the speaker and the Kutchi beneath.

poses._about: Her pose for each line (DOOR-02, Zafar, 20 Oct): standing listening before she speaks; the weather word and its sentence by the weather (pointing up or shading her eyes; the umbrella when raining, the fan when sunny); the day's lines in their order (wave on 'Come!', welcome on the day's line and the question); listening while she waits for the child's Ha!

cards._about: The sidebar's two cards (Zafar, 19 Oct night; idea 55): the weather card shows as the weather word is said (its picture: the day's own sky, framed on its sun, moon or clouds; the rain falls on it in code), the activity card as the day's line is said (its line marked thought in data/day.json). Under each picture the shared speaker and the card's word: the weather word (data/day.json weather.<w>.word), and the activity's word here (an engine meaning; what the engine can't say is its grey to-record English, decision 84). Pictures: a backdrop and, on it, sprites (x: their middle across, h: their height, both shares of the picture; feet on y).

thought._about: The thought bubble of the day's place, beside her head on the side away from her lines (its picture: data/day.json activities/trips thought)
